_comment: Pinned upstream inputs for the runtime bundle. release-runtime.yml downloads
exactly these URLs and refuses to continue unless the bytes hash to sha256.
Both artifacts are vendored into our own bucket rather than fetched from
UE4SS's GitHub releases. Upstream publishes experimental builds under the
MOVING tag 'experimental-latest': the assets under it are replaced as new
builds land, so a URL that worked yesterday can 404 or serve different bytes
tomorrow. That already cost us the build below — it is the one verified
working in game, and it is no longer downloadable from upstream at all.
These vendored keys are immutable by convention: the build identifier is in
the filename, so bumping UE4SS means uploading a new object and editing this
file, never overwriting an existing one.
To bump: download the new upstream release, upload it to runtime/vendor/,
put its URL and sha256 here, then verify in game that all four AOBs still

_provenance: The last modpack.zip, archived verbatim on 2026-08-01 from
modpack/latest/modpack.zip before anything could overwrite it. It carries
both matching the install the four AOB signatures were verified against.
It also contains MJOLNIR mods, because the modpack did. The build copies
only dwmapi.dll, UE4SS.dll, LICENSE and the four infrastructure mods out
of it, and asserts afterwards that no mods came along. Archived unmodified
on purpose: preservation should preserve, not repackage.
Supplies the base signature layer; /signatures overlays it. The only file
we take from here and do not override is gamepass/GUObjectHashTables.lua.
Note that this copy's Steam GUObjectHashTables.lua is the one that stopped
resolving after the 2026-08-01 game update. Upstream had not fixed it as of
this mirror, which is why the overlay is load-bearing.
